title: Sub-microliter Primer and gDNA Dispense
author: Rodolfo A Salido Benitez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ufbetin

steps.title: Prepare reagents and plates
steps.instruction: Thaw and centrifuge the primer, gDNA, and PCR plates.

substeps.instruction: Ensure centrifugation speed for echo qualified Low Dead Volume (LDV) plates does not exceed 1500rpm.

steps.title: Survey source plates (Optional)
steps.instruction: Verify that Primer and gDNA source plates contain sufficient material using the Echo 550 Liquid Handler software.

substeps.instruction: Open Echo 550 software and navigate to the Diagnostics tab.
Place the plate in the source plate tray with the appropriate insert and click 'Source Plate In'.
Under Miscellaneous, select 'Survey' from the dropdown menu and click 'Launch'.
Click 'Go' in the pop-up window to start the survey.
For 384-Well Polypropylene (PP) plates: use 2.10 mm insert, profile '384PP_AQ_BP2_HT', and ensure volumes are within 15 - 65 µL.
For 384-Well Low Dead Volume (LDV) plates: use 4.50 mm insert, profile '384LDV_AQ_B2_HT', and ensure volumes are within 3-12 µL.

steps.title: Dispense 16S primers
steps.instruction: Use the Echo Plate Reformat software to execute the 'Mini-PCR_primer_dispense.epr' protocol.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 200 nL of primers from each source well of the LDV source plate to the corresponding destination well.
Repeat for a total of 3 copies of the twin tec PCR destination plates.

steps.title: Dispense gDNA
steps.instruction: Execute the 'Mini-PCR_gDNA_dispense.epr' protocol using the Echo 550.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 200 nL of gDNA from each source well of the PP source plate to the corresponding destination well.
Repeat for the same 3 copies of the twin tec PCR destination plates used in the primer dispense step.

steps.title: Seal and centrifuge plates
steps.instruction: Seal all plates to prevent evaporation and contamination.

substeps.instruction: Seal all source plates with storage aluminum foils.
Seal all destination plates with thermo-cycler compatible aluminum foils.
